text:
Samir Patel: customer reported streaming responses get cut off when requests go through a gRPC->HTTP1.1 gateway. They see partial tokens, then client reconnects and gets duplicate tokens. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/RT-4821

Elena Ortiz: can you paste a minimal repro and which gateway? envoy or custom grpc-gateway? Also which model + endpoint?

Samir Patel: envoy in front of our edge; using model 'redwood-13b' via /v1/stream. Repro steps I got from customer:

1) Client opens HTTP/2 streaming to envoy
2) envoy translates to HTTP/1.1 chunked to upstream
3) after ~1.2s of tokens, upstream sends a final empty chunk and closes the socket
4) client sees truncated stream, then retries -> sees tail duplicates

Samir Patel: their simplified curl (note they used nghttp2 client):

```bash
curl --http2 -v "https://edge.redwood.example/v1/stream" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n  -H "Accept: text/event-stream"
```

Michael Chen: possible causes: envoy's `buffer_limit` / idle timeouts or HTTP/1.1 downstream flushing policy. Also check if envoy is adding `transfer-encoding: chunked` but not preserving SSE boundaries. When HTTP/2->HTTP/1.1 translation happens you can lose framing info.

Tess (oncall): @Samir can you grab `edge` and `upstream` request/response traces (x-request-id) and a pcap of the short session? we need to know if upstream closed with FIN or RST.

Samir Patel: attached the logs from customer (redacted):

```
[edge] -> recv client stream window 65536
[edge] -> forward headers to upstream (h1)
[upstream] -> send chunk: "data: {\"token\": \"Hello\"}\n\n"
[upstream] -> send final empty chunk
[edge] -> upstream closed, proxied 200 OK
```

Elena Ortiz: interesting — edge reports final empty chunk. Could be our runtime flushing a final empty chunk when KV cache hits or when early-exit path triggers. Also we recently changed `sse_trailer_mode` in runtime v14.

Michael Chen: quick checks:
- try `curl --no-buffer` vs `curl --http2-prior-knowledge` to reproduce
- compare with a direct call to our origin bypassing envoy (if bypass fixes, likely translation bug)
- check if `Connection: keep-alive` and `Content-Type: text/event-stream` survive translation

Samir Patel: customer says bypassing envoy (direct to origin) yields continuous stream no truncation. So this points to the gateway.

Gateway Bot: Notified envoy-team, created issue ENV-2931 with trace ids: trace-83f7a

Tess (oncall): for support action plan:
- ask customer to collect a tcpdump of the failing session
- instruct them to enable `envoy.filters.http.streamed_manifest` (if available) or disable `use_downstream_protocol` in the envoy cluster
- reproduce with a small nodejs client that aggressively reconnects to validate duplicate token pattern

Samir Patel: also flagging billing: customer reported being charged twice for partial stream + reconnect. Finance: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-9001

Elena Ortiz: I'll prepare a scoped repro script (node + curl) and post it here. If we can reproduce, ops can test envoy config suggestions.

Support Bot: ticket RT-4821 updated: asked customer for pcap + x-request-ids + repro curl. Assigned to Elena.

Samir Patel: thanks all. will follow up with customer logs and the pcap when they send it. :thumbsup:
